title: Comptes rendus de la première Conférence générale des poids et mesures
authors: General Conference on Weights and Measures
version: Official French proceedings of the 1889 meeting, BIPM digitization, PDF version 1.3

passages.locator: 26 September 1889, pp. 34–40, sanction and allocation by lot
passages.note: Delegates sanctioned the international prototypes of the metre and kilogram, the national prototypes and the certified values relative to the international prototypes. Table on p. 40 assigns kilogram prototypes 4 and 20 to the United States.
